settings.heading: Gold Membership
settings.row_content:
WHAT YOU GET

  • Each month, get $200 credit* applicable towards the services of your choice (some exclusions apply),
  • Accumulate credits to access higher priced services
  • Applicable toward full price services only, cannot be combined with any promotion, discount or rebate. Excluded from exchanges.
  • Bring a friend who is new to SKIN SPA and they get 30% OFF their first treatment!

 

TERMS

  • Membership fee billed on 1st of each month
  • Cancelable at any time, before the 20th of each month, after 3 months of membership (for the 1 month initial offer or 6 months for the 3 months initial offer). Simply email-us your request or cancel online.
  • Membership fee can’t be combined with any other offer
  • Non-transferable
  • No cash value
  • Members are encouraged to tip on the full price of services
  • Membership cannot be frozen
  • ID verification is required for treatments
  • No refunds or credit for lesser value services
  • Price subject to change with 30 days notice

*your account must be in perfect standing.

Our Skin Spa NYC – Flatiron/Chelsea Medical Spa Services
Cosmetic Injectables
settings.text:
Enhance your natural beauty with our range of cosmetic injectables:

  • Neuromodulators: Smooth out wrinkles and fine lines using Botox, Dysport, or Xeomin. Ideal for areas like the forehead, crow's feet, and frown lines. Treatments are typically recommended every 3–4 months.
  • Dermal Fillers: Restore volume and rejuvenate your skin with Juvederm, Restylane, Radiesse, or Sculptra. Common treatment areas include cheeks, lips, jawline, and under-eye hollows.

settings.heading: Medical Spa Treatments
settings.text: Address various skin concerns with our advanced med-spa services:

settings.heading: Laser Hair Removal
settings.text:
Achieve long-lasting smoothness with our laser hair removal services:

  • Effective for various skin types and areas, including legs, arms, underarms, and bikini line.
  • Typically requires a series of six or more sessions for optimal results.
  • Customized treatment plans based on individual skin and hair types.
settings.button_label: Learn More About Laser Hair Removal

settings.heading: Waxing Services
settings.text:
Experience quick and efficient hair removal with our waxing options:

  • We offer both hard and soft waxes to suit different skin sensitivities.
  • Services available for various areas, including eyebrows, legs, arms, and bikini.
  • Strict hygiene protocols are followed, including a no double-dipping policy.

settings.heading: Facial Treatments
settings.text:
Revitalize your skin with our comprehensive facial services:

  • Customized Facial: Tailored to your skin type and concerns, this 50-minute treatment includes cleansing, exfoliation, extractions, and hydration.
  • Microdermabrasion: A non-invasive procedure that exfoliates the skin, reducing fine lines and improving texture.
  • Power Peel: Combines chemical exfoliation with nourishing serums to address hyperpigmentation and uneven skin tone.
  • HydraFacial: A multi-step treatment that cleanses, exfoliates, and hydrates the skin, leaving it refreshed and glowing.

settings.heading: Massage Therapy
settings.text:
Relax and rejuvenate with our range of massage therapies:

  • Prenatal Massage: Designed to alleviate pregnancy-related discomfort and promote relaxation.
  • Deep Tissue Massage: Targets deeper layers of muscle to relieve chronic tension and pain.
  • Swedish Massage: Utilizes gentle techniques to promote relaxation and improve circulation.
  • Himalayan Hot Salt Stone Massage: Combines warm salt stones with massage techniques to soothe muscles and balance energy.

settings.heading: Body Treatments
settings.text: Enhance your body's appearance and feel with our specialized treatments

settings.title: Daphne Duran, DNP
settings.text:
is a highly skilled Nurse Practitioner with over 19 years of medical experience, specializing in internal medicine and aesthetic medicine. Based in New York, Daphne serves as a Nurse Practitioner in primary care for NYU and is also a prominent Aesthetic Nurse Practitioner at Skin Spa New York, where she expertly combines medical knowledge with a passion for beauty and wellness.

As the owner of Juvenescence Aesthetics med spa and aesthetic injector for skin spa New York, Daphne provides advanced aesthetic treatments tailored to enhance natural beauty and boost confidence. Her extensive background in medicine allows her to approach aesthetics with a clinical eye, ensuring safe, effective, and personalized care for each client. Daphne’s dedication to her craft and her patients has made her a trusted figure in both the medical and aesthetic communities.

Her compassionate approach, combined with her comprehensive expertise, positions her as a leader in the field, committed to patient well-being and positive outcomes across all aspects of care.
